parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the parameter. The name can be up to 180 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (\_). The name cannot start with ALIYUN, ACS, ALIBABA, ALICLOUD, or OOS.

parameters.name: ParameterVersion
parameters.description: The version number of the parameter. Valid values: 1 to 100.

parameters.name: WithDecryption
parameters.description: Specifies whether to decrypt the parameter value. The Value field in the response is returned only if this parameter is set to true. Otherwise, the Value field is empty.
